name: Shiritsu Otoko no Ko Gakuen - Mou Oma○ko Nante Iranai
original_name: 私立男の娘学園 もうおま○こなんていらないっ
source: Yuuta made a mistake enrolling in a private school whose purpose is to train boys to become fine otokonoko. He didn't sign for this but will he be able to go against his new education?
translation: Yuuta made a mistake enrolling in a private school whose purpose is to train boys to become fine otokonoko. He didn't sign for this but will he be able to go against his new education?
